question: Which country was the host of the 15th G20 Leaders’ Summit 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia**__.

__
 
• **Saudi Arabia** was the host of the** 15th G20 Leaders’ Summit 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 15th G20 Leaders’ Summit 2020** was scheduled to take place in **Riyadh,** the capital city of Saudi Arabia, on **21–22 November 2020**.
 
• Due to the** COVID-19 pandemic**, it was held **virtually**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **G20**** works** to address major issues related to the global economy, such as i**nternational financial stability, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development**.
 
• The** G20 is composed of most** of the **world's largest economies**, including both industrialized and developing nations, and accounts for around **90% of gross world product (GWP), 75–80% of international trade, two-thirds of the global population**, and roughly half the world's land area.
 
• The** G20 or Group of Twenty is an intergovernmental forum** comprising 19 countries and the European Union (EU).
 
• The members of the G20 are Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Indonesia, Italy, Japan, Republic of Korea, Mexico, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Turkey, the United Kingdom, the United States, and the European Union.

• The G20 was founded on **26th September 1999**.
 
• The first G20 summit was held in **Washington DC (USA) **in** 2008**.
 
• The 16th gG0 summit venue - **Rome (Italy) 2021**.
 
• The 17th gG0 summit venue - **Indonesia (Bali) 2022**.
 
• The 18th G20 summit venue - **India (New Delhi) 2023**.
 
• **Joko Widodo (President of Indonesia)** is the** Chairman of the G20 Summit**.
